statement.zh-TW: 能從本期淨利、股本與每股面額算出每股盈餘，並說明它是本益比的分母
statement.en: Work out earnings per share from profit for the period, share capital and par value per share, and explain that it is the denominator of the P/E ratio

text.zh-TW: 把股本金額直接當成股數來除
text.en: Dividing by the amount of share capital as if it were the number of shares

text.zh-TW: 以為算每股盈餘要用到股價
text.en: Thinking the share price is needed to calculate earnings per share

text.zh-TW: 把營業收入當成每股盈餘的分子
text.en: Using revenue instead of profit as the numerator of earnings per share

text.zh-TW: 用本期淨利總額而不是每股盈餘當本益比的分母
text.en: Using total profit for the period instead of earnings per share as the denominator of the P/E ratio

statement.zh-TW: 能用股價與每股盈餘說明本益比的意思，判讀倍數高低代表市場為每一元盈餘付出的價格，並分辨每股盈餘為零時本益比算不出來（N/A），為負時算出的倍數不具解釋意義
statement.en: Explain the P/E ratio in terms of share price and earnings per share, read a high or low multiple as the price the market pays per unit of profit, and tell apart zero earnings per share, where the ratio cannot be computed (N/A), from negative earnings per share, where the multiple is not meaningful

text.zh-TW: 以為本益比越高，公司就越賺錢
text.en: Thinking a higher P/E ratio means the company is more profitable

text.zh-TW: 以為本益比低一定代表便宜、值得買
text.en: Thinking a low P/E ratio always means a bargain worth buying

text.zh-TW: 以為虧損公司的本益比是零或負數仍可比較
text.en: Thinking a loss-making company has a P/E ratio of zero or a negative one that can still be compared

text.zh-TW: 以為本益比是財務報表上的一列
text.en: Thinking the P/E ratio is a line on the financial statements

statement.zh-TW: 能說明用本益比估價的前提與限制（歷史或預估每股盈餘、產業差異、一次性損益），並分辨會計觀念練習與投資建議
statement.en: Explain the assumptions and limits of valuing with a P/E multiple (trailing or forward earnings, industry differences, one-off items), and tell an accounting concept exercise apart from investment advice

text.zh-TW: 以為歷史每股盈餘與預估每股盈餘可以互換使用
text.en: Treating trailing and forward earnings per share as interchangeable

text.zh-TW: 以為不同產業的本益比可以直接比高低
text.en: Comparing P/E ratios across industries as if they were directly comparable

text.zh-TW: 把一次性的處分利益也當成本業的賺錢能力
text.en: Counting a one-off disposal gain as core earning power

text.zh-TW: 以為算出「合理價」就等於買賣建議
text.en: Thinking that a calculated fair price amounts to a recommendation to buy or sell
